name: Kashimashi ~Girl Meets Girl~ "Hajimete no Natsu Monogatari."
original_name: かしまし ～ガール・ミーツ・ガール～ 「初めての夏物語。」
source:
Based on the manga and anime series by Satoru Akahori of the same name.

The game's story begins on the outset of summer vacation. Hazumu's homeroom teacher Namiko Tsuki suggests Hazumu and her friends take a one-week trip to a small mountain village with a hot spring resort. Hazumu's grandparents reside in this town, and are two new characters introduced to the story. Three other female characters are introduced as possible love interests for Hazumu; two are the same age as her, and the third is the older landlady of the resort.

The goal of the game is to pair Hazumu up with one of the five female cast of characters. The gameplay's main system comes from Hazumu's indecisive personality. If the player shows more interest in a particular character, the other characters get annoyed that Hazumu is ignoring them, which is displayed in a tension meter. The more Hazumu ignores a particular character, the higher the tension between that character becomes. This ensures Hazumu stays good friends with the possible love interests. In order to view the ending of a particular character, a certain amount of tension will have to be between the other characters, but this cannot be too great or the ending will not show.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kashimashi:_Girl_Meets_Girl#Visual_novel]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
本作改編自赤堀悟創作的同名漫畫與動畫系列。

故事從暑假開始。大佛彈的導師月並子建議她和朋友們去一個擁有溫泉度假村的小山村旅行一週。彈的祖父母住在這座小鎮上，他們也是故事中登場的新角色。遊戲還會介紹三名可能成為彈戀愛對象的女性角色：其中兩人與她同齡，第三位則是度假村的年長老闆娘。

遊戲目標是讓彈與五名女性角色中的一人結成情侶。主要系統源於彈優柔寡斷的性格：如果玩家對某個角色表現出更多興趣，其他角色就會因彈忽視她們而不滿，並以緊張度計量表顯示。彈越忽視某個角色，她與該角色之間的緊張度就越高。這能讓彈與可能的戀愛對象保持良好朋友關係。要觀看某個角色的結局，其他角色之間必須達到一定緊張度；但緊張度也不能過高，否則結局不會出現。

［改編自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kashimashi:_Girl_Meets_Girl#Visual_novel]維基百科[/url]］
